meta.name: category-designer
meta.description: Define a new category where your product wins by default. Reframe the buying decision. Triggers on: "create a category", "category design", "define my category", "category of one", "reframe the market", "position as category king", "new category", "category creation", "own a category", "category strategy", "competitive positioning", "strategic positioning", "market reframing", "be the only option", "change the buying criteria", "category king".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新定义市场品类，让产品成为默认首选
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品或品牌创造并占据一个全新品类
copy.tagline_en: Redefine your market category to make your product the default choice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and own a new category for your product or brand

howto.what: Claude会分析你的产品和市场，设计一个新品类（category），让你的产品默认胜出。它重新定义购买标准，生成品类名称、视角、内容角度等资产。
howto.when: 当你提到“create a category”、“category design”等关键词，或要求进行市场重新定位、差异化时触发。

say.text: 帮我为我的AI视频工具创建一个新品类。
say.note: Claude会分析产品并设计品类框架。

say.text: 如何重新定义购买标准，让我的产品脱颖而出？
设计一个品类，让我的产品成为唯一选择。
say.note: Claude会生成品类故事和内容路线图。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your product and market to design a new category where your product wins by default. It reframes buying criteria and outputs category name, POV, content angles, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "create a category", "category design", or ask for market reframing or differentiation.

say_en.text: Create a new category for my AI video tool.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the product and design a category.

say_en.text: How can I reframe buying criteria to stand out?
say_en.note: Claude will design new buying criteria.

say_en.text: Design a category where my product is the only option.
say_en.note: Claude will generate category story and content roadmap.
